units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 2:1">Ib. II, 1</cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּטָרִים</he>, constr. <he>פִּטְרֵי</he>, <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פִּי׳</he></cite>.
